description: Source code for VideoDmpWriter class handling video dump writing, including file management, static callbacks for player events, and data serialization.

classes.name: PlayerToWriterMap
classes.description: Manages mapping between SbPlayer instances and their corresponding VideoDmpWriter objects, with thread safety.

classes.name: VideoDmpWriter
classes.description: Handles writing video dump data to files, including configuration and access unit data, with static callback methods for player events.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::VideoDmpWriter
methods.description: Constructor that creates a dump file with a unique name and writes initial headers.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::~VideoDmpWriter
methods.description: Destructor that closes the dump file.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::OnPlayerCreate
methods.description: Static callback invoked when a player is created; registers the player and dumps configuration.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::OnPlayerWriteSample
methods.description: Static callback invoked when a sample is written; dumps the access unit.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::OnPlayerDestroy
methods.description: Static callback invoked when a player is destroyed; unregisters the player.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::DumpConfigs
methods.description: Writes configuration data for audio and video codecs.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::DumpAccessUnit
methods.description: Serializes and writes an input buffer (audio/video sample) to the dump file.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::WriteToFile
methods.description: Writes a buffer to the dump file and records the write statistics.
